'''Elemack''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[Titan Base]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]].<ref name="OSG" />
